name: What is diminished value in San Diego car accident claims?

mainEntity.name: What is diminished value in San Diego car accident claims?

acceptedAnswer.text: Diminished value is the loss in your vehicle’s market value after an accident, even if repaired. You can claim this loss if you prove your car’s resale value has decreased due to accident history.missionlegalcenter​
